title: potentilla fruticosa f. micrandra
intro: Potentilla fruticosa f. micrandra, commonly known as dwarf shrub cinquefoil, is a type of flowering plant that is native to the mountainous regions of Asia and Europe. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, making it useful in the treatment of various conditions such as wounds, infections, and cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla fruticosa f. micrandra include protecting against cell damage, reducing inflammation, and inhibiting the growth of bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoid saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
